verses.text: Woe to those at ease in Zion
Cross over to Calneh and see;
You dismiss the day of calamity
You lie on beds inlaid with ivory,
You improvise songs on the harp like David
You drink wine by the bowlful
Therefore, you will now go into exile
The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself—the LORD, the God of Hosts, has declared:
And if there are ten men left in one house, they too will die.

And when the relative who is to burn the bodies picks them up to remove them from the house, he will call to one inside, “Is anyone else with you?” “None,” that person will answer. “Silence,” the relative will retort, “for the name of the LORD must not be invoked.”
For the LORD gives a command:
you who rejoice in Lo-debar and say,
For behold, I will raise up a nation
